name: Smoked Beef Sausages
desc: Pure beef, seasoned with our house spice, filled by hand and hung over a wood fire until deep amber. Fully smoked — warm through on the pan or grill.

name: Beef Hot Dogs
desc: Long, juicy and fully smoked. Simmer or grill for a few minutes and they’re ready for the bun.

name: Minced Beef
desc: 100% beef, minced the same morning it’s packed. For sauces, burgers, samosas and stews.

name: Lean Minced Beef
desc: An extra-lean cut, trimmed before mincing, for lighter family meals and less fat in the pan.
